changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Apply each accepted cancellation exactly once without adding writes to normal order and trade paths
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE wallet_service.order_cancellation_applications ( cancellation_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, order_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, user_id UUID NOT NULL, side VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL, limit_price INTEGER NOT NULL, cancelled_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, applied_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_order_cancellation_side CHECK (side IN ('BUY', 'SELL')), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_order_cancellation_price CHECK (limit_price > 0), CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_order_cancellation_quantity CHECK (cancelled_quantity > 0) );

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Remove the unused Wallet prerequisite state; asset shortfalls are permanent consistency conflicts

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Enforce non-negative aggregate Wallet balances as the database safety boundary
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE wallet_service.wallets ADD CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_available_amount_non_negative CHECK (available_amount >= 0) NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_locked_amount_non_negative CHECK (locked_amount >= 0) NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_available_currency_non_negative CHECK (available_currency >= 0) NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_locked_currency_non_negative CHECK (locked_currency >= 0) NOT VALID;
ALTER TABLE wallet_service.wallets VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_available_amount_non_negative; ALTER TABLE wallet_service.wallets VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_locked_amount_non_negative; ALTER TABLE wallet_service.wallets VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_available_currency_non_negative; ALTER TABLE wallet_service.wallets VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_wallet_locked_currency_non_negative;

changeSet.author: eap
changeSet.comment: Rename the Wallet asset-reservation success integration contract
changeSet.sql: UPDATE wallet_service.outbox SET event_type = 'OrderAssetReservationSucceededEvent', routing_key = 'order.asset-reservation.succeeded', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_type = 'OrderConfirmedEvent' AND status <> 'SENT';
